clauses.assertion: The participant gateway rejects invalid club or session identities and subscribes to the exact authorized club-session topic; database RLS limits a participant to a joined session.

tests.name: GAME-MOB-03 subscribes to one club session and recovers unexpected close
a participant subscribes only to invalidation events for their joined session

clauses.assertion: Realtime events are privacy-safe version hints that trigger a projection refresh and never become authoritative participant state.

tests.name: reconciles after a newer invalidation hint
runtime events are club-scoped privacy-safe hints that require snapshot reconciliation

clauses.assertion: Initial load and every accepted invalidation fetch the server-authoritative participant projection carrying session and event versions.

tests.name: reconciles after a newer invalidation hint
submits expected versions and accepts an authoritative response

clauses.assertion: Scope, session version, and event sequence are compared before adoption so stale, duplicate, wrong-session, and out-of-order hints or projections cannot roll state backward.

tests.name: ignores duplicate, stale, and wrong-scope hints
keeps a newer Realtime answer confirmation over a stale response

clauses.assertion: Recovery scheduling derives its deadline delta from the projection server time and phase deadline, not the device wall clock.

tests.name: GAME-QA-04 clock skew uses authoritative server-time deadline delta

clauses.assertion: The participant client can fetch a projection and submit a versioned answer only; it contains no scoring, settlement, or lifecycle-transition RPC ownership.

tests.name: submits expected versions and accepts an authoritative response
rejects a stale mutation response as a contract failure

clauses.assertion: Channel error, timeout, or unexpected close produces a sanitized recovery signal; cancellation removes the channel and suppresses teardown noise.

tests.name: GAME-MOB-03 subscribes to one club session and recovers unexpected close
recovers from a Realtime channel error with a fresh snapshot
